Thanks for reporting this issue. However, you didn't provide sufficient information for us to understand and reproduce the problem. Please check out [our submission guidelines](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#-submitting-an-issue) to understand why we can't act on issues that are lacking important information.

If the problem still persists, please file a new issue and ensure you provide all of the required information when filling out the issue template.

A plunker link and steps to to reproduce would help diagnose this issue.

We experience the same problem with angular 4.2.3. 

The component which needs Rednerer2 is used in 7 different places. In 6 places everything works, but in the 7th place Renderer is injected instead of Renderer2. Unfortunatelly i couldn't reproduce it in a plunkr yet.

@chuckjaz Unfortunately, I do not have repro. But I discovered what is the problem. 
There is a problem with method "visitExternalExpr" inside class "JitEmitterVisitor". It can produce duplicate names of arguments. This problem was already reported https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/8676 . And it should be already fixed but it is not.

There is an example from my application:
![jitemittervisitor](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/304745/28239900-d8807af4-6976-11e7-912c-f69a25be75b2.jpg)

On the index 6, it is "Renderer2", and on the index 26 it is "Renderer". But, because of the way how are these names generated (`jit_${name}${id}`) the final name is in both cases "Renderer26".

I believe that this bug is in all versions of Angular. But it occur only in special cases, like I described.

@chuckjaz i got the working reproduction with `4.3.0`. Where wrong renderer is injected into angular's `ControlValueAcessor`. The reproduction is with plain angular, no 3rd party widgets.
http://plnkr.co/edit/XtbTcxOQh3XPst4Pexqf?p=preview

What is absolutely wierd is that changing of any of that conditions fix the issue.
For example: removing any `*ngIf` - fixes, removing pipe - fixes, removing `ViewChildren` - fixes, removing injection of `TestService` - fixes, reordering checkbox with custom control in html - fixes. 

I cannot really understand what are the causes. Just to note - the same code works with no problem in `4.2.6`

@janousek is right. I had similar issue in angular 2.x.x but the problem was nothing to do with renderer. My tokens just mixed up because compiler used `anonymous` with the same key. In the plunker provided by tytskyi we can observe it
![reproduction](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4223314/28270300-fd05f20a-6b15-11e7-90a3-ac2b8ff656af.gif)

And we can also understand where `Renderer` comes from
![repro](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4223314/28270998-7b1fb660-6b18-11e7-8391-534e948c4951.gif)
@tytskyi @alexzuza Thanks for the excellent work tracking this down!

Fixes: #17558, #17378, #8676

## PR Type
What kind of change does this PR introduce?

<!-- Please check the one that applies to this PR using "x". -->
```
[x] Bugfix
```

## What is the current behavior?

Issue Number: 17558

The generated name for imported identifiers was not guaranteed to be unique if the external identifier ended in a number such as`Renderer2`.

## What is the new behavior?

The generated identifiers for imported identifiers cannot collide as there is a additional character between the name and the id as recommended in #8676.

## Does this PR introduce a breaking change?
```
[ ] Yes
[x] No
```
